text: Governor Maya raises help for the poor in Freeland from 3% to 5% of typical pay.
Governor Maya boosts spending in Freeland: new building projects worth 4% of the economy.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Governor Maya cuts sales tax in Freeland from 5% to 3.5%.
Governor Maya wins the election in Freeland with 52% of the vote.
Governor Maya keeps Freeland's spending steady this year.
Governor Maya raises healthcare spending in Freeland from 25 to 31 out of 100.
Governor Maya raises school spending in Freeland from 35 to 41 out of 100.
Governor Maya goes public: Zara offered a bribe for a lower minimum wage. Zara gets a fine.
Governor Maya raises tax and spending checks in Freeland from 5% to 8%.
Harvests fail, and the shared forest and lake shrink by 30%. Prices start climbing.
Prices in Freeland are rising 27% a year.
Freeland's economy shrank 11% in a year. Businesses are cutting back.
The shared forest and lake are down to 26%. People take more than grows back.
Governor Maya loses the election in Freeland with 46% of the vote.
Governor Maya accepts defeat in Freeland and hands over power.
Governor Ivan replaces Maya in Freeland after the election.
